records.subject: A quick nudge about your Wrenfield workspace
records.body:
Hi Nora,

A lot of teams stall right at inviting their first teammate. If that's where things got stuck, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Thanks,

records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Union Media* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 6 (2026-08-27) shows recent momentum, and Nora replied positively [email:cb6b1057], but no invite sent and no key milestone with 8 days left; solo Starter user with low engagement after two outreaches [email:cbc14a5d, email:e4fce102] makes it roughly a coin flip, slightly under.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Thanks for the note last week — glad to hear it. I saw you got your first project set up, which is the main thing: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them.

If it's useful, I'm happy to walk through adding the first set of tasks with you on a short call this week — or I can answer by email if that's easier. And whenever the rest of the team is ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Best,
Chidi
